71310133.name: Sodium dicarbollylcobaltate(III)

71587253.name: Lithium aspartate
71587253.description: Lithium aspartate is a salt of aspartic acid and lithium.

90311989.name: Bictegravir
90311989.description: Bictegravir is a second-generation integrase inhibitor class that was structurally derived from an earlier compound dolutegravir by scientists at Gilead Sciences.

112500533.name: 5-MAPDB
112500533.description: 5-MAPDB, also known as 5-(2- propyl)-2,3-dihydrobenzofuran, is an entactogen of the dihydrobenzofuran family.

118597685.name: Zavondemstat
118597685.description: Zavondemstat is a drug which acts as an inhibitor of the enzyme lysine-specific demethylase 4 .

121425461.name: Velufenacin
121425461.description: Velufenacin is a muscarinic antagonist that operates on the M3 receptor and is tissue-selective for bladder over salivary glands. It is in development as a treatment for overactive bladder.

154734773.name: Nanocar

155524917.name: MC3138
155524917.description: MC3138 is a drug which acts as a sirtuin-5 activator. It has potential applications in the treatment of pancreatic cancer, as well as basic research into the function of the SIRT5 enzyme complex.

900000053.name: 5-Allyloxy-AMT
900000053.description: 5-Allyloxy-AMT, also known as 5-allyloxy-α-methyltryptamine, is a serotonin 5-HT2 receptor agonist of the tryptamine, 5-alkyloxytryptamine, and α-alkyltryptamine families.

900000309.name: Botulinum toxin

900000437.name: Cemiplimab
900000437.description: Cemiplimab, sold under the brand name Libtayo, is a monoclonal antibody medication used for the treatment of squamous cell skin cancer.

900000565.name: Daratumumab

900000693.name: Eflapegrastim

900000821.name: Ferrotungsten

900000949.name: Holmium oxychloride

900001333.name: Nemolizumab
